style: simple chunky flat pixel art charcoal ash with broad cool light gray planes, thin ash torso, attached blunt jaw stump with EMPTY air above, arm fused into curved bow, pale straight string, lower body one ash mound

move.action: Dragging ash cycle: thin upper torso leans right first, mound compresses and follows slightly, torso settles as mound spreads, returns near first pose. Arm-bow and pulled string stay forward, attached jaw stump remains without upper head. No legs, no extra limbs, no detached particles, stationary root.

attack.action: Ash archer fires: ready arm-bow, rear hand pulls string farther back as shoulder compresses, string releases and torso sinks slightly, lowered weary recovery keeping attached jaw stump and empty air above. No detached projectile or particles, one connected ash body, no skull or head restored.

hit.action: Impact: ready thin ash body, shoulder and chest indent inward from impact, upper torso slumps slightly toward mound, returns near ready contour. Arms and curved arm-bow remain connected. Jaw stump only, no restored face/head, no particles.

dead.action: Collapse from top: ready ash upper torso, attached jaw and shoulders sink into chest, torso folds into low connected mound and arm-bow lowers, final flat ash mound with curved arm-bow remnant and pale string resting touching ash. No detached parts, no restored skull, no humanoid legs, no recovery.
